progression_method.rule: Named next squat load 62.5 kg at same 3 x 5 only after repeated comparable response supports it and equipment increment exists; RDL/accessories held
progression_method.minimum_evidence: Repeated comparable exposures with technically competent execution, target reserve/reporting and acceptable recovery; contrary/missing evidence considered; no universal number of sessions
progression_method.observation_hysteresis: Single good/bad set updates facts only unless immediate task validity issue
progression_method.advance_axis: Load OR reps OR set count first; finite next candidate identified; whole-week/hybrid review required

autoregulation.within: Only named preaccepted kg/reps/set/rest variant after current observation supports exact alternative; no generic fatigue % reduction
autoregulation.overperformance: Record actual extra reserve/reps; hold rest of adequate session; evaluate between-cycle opportunity using repeated pattern
autoregulation.underperformance: Reconcile units/task/rest; no causal conclusion; named reduction/termination of future work only if adequate and authorized
autoregulation.unknown_rir: Do not award progression; reestablish reporting or use covered alternative method; HOLD only dependent judgment

missed_session.rule: Confirm actually missed versus unsynced. Preserve adequate remainder; no doubling sets/reps or automatic next-day makeup
missed_session.reschedule: Only if feasible, stimulus necessary and complete next-session/hybrid horizon valid; explicit material move confirmation
missed_session.progression: Missed opportunity is NOT_EVALUATED, not failed task or volume debt

deload_taper.deload: Use explicit reduced-work variant of same familiar configuration when reviewed; inspect need rather than fixed calendar/percentage
deload_taper.taper: Coordinate event objective and strength priority; no generic run taper automatically cancels strength
deload_taper.return: Known nonclinical pause requires new applicability/load context; clinical or unknown reason cannot use this generic recipe

substitutions.rule: Compare purpose, known competence/equipment, load basis, ROM/rest, demand and lost specificity; rebase configuration-specific history
substitutions.named_example: STR-LOWER-STRENGTH -> STR-SUB-DB only with known DB task loads; barbell strength specificity and dose not equivalent

demand_assessment.input_equation: Exercise metadata x prescription x athlete/context -> demand assessment. Keep local region exposure, systemic expectation, novelty, uncertainty and actual response separate; never multiply into an unvalidated universal score.
demand_assessment.qualitative: Lower primary-group exposure plus substantial task/dose-dependent local demand; next run assessed, not presumed impaired
demand_assessment.local: Named primary/secondary group exposure plus task-specific observed response; no fixed recovery clock
demand_assessment.systemic: Qualitative expectation evaluated with full actual training history; no duplicate fatigue summation
demand_assessment.confidence: Conditional on context/familiarity; LOW if novelty/effort method uncertain

mutation_envelope.finite_reduction: If accepted beforehand: omit final accessory set OR omit final main set with lost stimulus visible; not interchangeable and not always sufficient
mutation_envelope.finite_progression: Named next squat load 62.5 kg at same 3 x 5 only after repeated comparable response supports it and equipment increment exists; RDL/accessories held
mutation_envelope.forbidden: Unlisted load/reps/rest changes, novel substitution, independent modality replan or completed-set rewrite
mutation_envelope.completed_prefix: Immutable; only remaining sets can be proposed
mutation_envelope.inside: Only an already accepted named branch can execute as plan execution. A fresh change of the chosen plan requires B even within potential envelope; exact current agency and reviewed dose still required.

volume_by_pattern_or_muscle.secondary_group_attribution: Stored as overlap only, not added to systemic physical sets; no effective-set fractions
volume_by_pattern_or_muscle.per_side_rule: Unilateral prescription is reps per side; time/exposure include both sides; physical work-set count uses one named bilateral-pair set record, with paired side results

load_establishment.method: Use comparable known task load at target reps/reserve under present context; no generic %1RM or automatic max test
load_establishment.example_kg: Synthetic established loads only; no direct source certifies exact kg

effort_method.primary: Estimated RIR immediately after work set
effort_method.uncertainty: RIR skill/error varies; no numeric estimate from completion alone; distinguish session RPE from set effort and pain
effort_method.failure: Not a default requirement; never seek failure to calibrate unknown beginner RIR

rest_density.rule: Use per-exercise target rest; athlete can delay for control; actual rest retained; compressing rest is a demand change
rest_density.superset_drop_set: Not in this finite catalog; require separate structure/metadata/dose review, not silent time-saving

progression_method.rule: No automatic progression; retain/rebase according to actual strength trend and goal
progression_method.minimum_evidence: Repeated comparable exposures with technically competent execution, target reserve/reporting and acceptable recovery; contrary/missing evidence considered; no universal number of sessions
progression_method.observation_hysteresis: Single good/bad set updates facts only unless immediate task validity issue
progression_method.advance_axis: Load OR reps OR set count first; finite next candidate identified; whole-week/hybrid review required

autoregulation.within: Only named preaccepted kg/reps/set/rest variant after current observation supports exact alternative; no generic fatigue % reduction
autoregulation.overperformance: Record actual extra reserve/reps; hold rest of adequate session; evaluate between-cycle opportunity using repeated pattern
autoregulation.underperformance: Reconcile units/task/rest; no causal conclusion; named reduction/termination of future work only if adequate and authorized
autoregulation.unknown_rir: Do not award progression; reestablish reporting or use covered alternative method; HOLD only dependent judgment

missed_session.rule: Confirm actually missed versus unsynced. Preserve adequate remainder; no doubling sets/reps or automatic next-day makeup
missed_session.reschedule: Only if feasible, stimulus necessary and complete next-session/hybrid horizon valid; explicit material move confirmation
missed_session.progression: Missed opportunity is NOT_EVALUATED, not failed task or volume debt

deload_taper.deload: Use explicit reduced-work variant of same familiar configuration when reviewed; inspect need rather than fixed calendar/percentage
deload_taper.taper: Coordinate event objective and strength priority; no generic run taper automatically cancels strength
deload_taper.return: Known nonclinical pause requires new applicability/load context; clinical or unknown reason cannot use this generic recipe

substitutions.rule: Compare purpose, known competence/equipment, load basis, ROM/rest, demand and lost specificity; rebase configuration-specific history
substitutions.named_example: STR-LOWER-STRENGTH -> STR-SUB-DB only with known DB task loads; barbell strength specificity and dose not equivalent

demand_assessment.input_equation: Exercise metadata x prescription x athlete/context -> demand assessment. Keep local region exposure, systemic expectation, novelty, uncertainty and actual response separate; never multiply into an unvalidated universal score.
demand_assessment.qualitative: Reduced set exposure relative to development recipe; not zero recovery burden
demand_assessment.local: Named primary/secondary group exposure plus task-specific observed response; no fixed recovery clock
demand_assessment.systemic: Qualitative expectation evaluated with full actual training history; no duplicate fatigue summation
demand_assessment.confidence: Conditional on context/familiarity; LOW if novelty/effort method uncertain

mutation_envelope.finite_reduction: If accepted beforehand: omit final accessory set OR omit final main set with lost stimulus visible; not interchangeable and not always sufficient
mutation_envelope.finite_progression: No automatic progression; retain/rebase according to actual strength trend and goal
mutation_envelope.forbidden: Unlisted load/reps/rest changes, novel substitution, independent modality replan or completed-set rewrite
mutation_envelope.completed_prefix: Immutable; only remaining sets can be proposed
mutation_envelope.inside: Only an already accepted named branch can execute as plan execution. A fresh change of the chosen plan requires B even within potential envelope; exact current agency and reviewed dose still required.

stop_hold_conditions: Persistent pain, injury/illness return, new functional limitation, pathology or clearance dependency -> CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED; no substitute dose
Unknown task eligibility/initial load or invalid equipment convention -> ASK/HOLD dependent task
Relevant task control loss -> stop set and reassess; no generic reduced load as clinical workaround

uncertainty_handling.confidence: No numeric score; rationale names method, history, applicability and data gap
uncertainty_handling.ASK: Only missing input that can change action; retain unsupported quantity null
uncertainty_handling.unsupported: Do not expose candidate finite dose as approved real prescription

missed_session.rule: Confirm actually missed versus unsynced. Preserve adequate remainder; no doubling sets/reps or automatic next-day makeup

deload_taper.deload: Use explicit reduced-work variant of same familiar configuration when reviewed; inspect need rather than fixed calendar/percentage
deload_taper.taper: Coordinate event objective and strength priority; no generic run taper automatically cancels strength

substitutions.rule: Compare purpose, known competence/equipment, load basis, ROM/rest, demand and lost specificity; rebase configuration-specific history

load_establishment.method: Use comparable known task load at target reps/reserve under present context; no generic %1RM or automatic max test
load_establishment.example_kg: Synthetic established loads only; no direct source certifies exact kg

effort_method.primary: Estimated RIR immediately after work set
effort_method.uncertainty: RIR skill/error varies; no numeric estimate from completion alone; distinguish session RPE from set effort and pain
effort_method.failure: Not a default requirement; never seek failure to calibrate unknown beginner RIR

rest_density.rule: Use per-exercise target rest; athlete can delay for control; actual rest retained; compressing rest is a demand change
rest_density.superset_drop_set: Not in this finite catalog; require separate structure/metadata/dose review, not silent time-saving

progression_method.rule: Own new configuration history; barbell PR/estimated 1RM is not migrated
progression_method.minimum_evidence: Repeated comparable exposures with technically competent execution, target reserve/reporting and acceptable recovery; contrary/missing evidence considered; no universal number of sessions
progression_method.observation_hysteresis: Single good/bad set updates facts only unless immediate task validity issue
progression_method.advance_axis: Load OR reps OR set count first; finite next candidate identified; whole-week/hybrid review required

autoregulation.within: Only named preaccepted kg/reps/set/rest variant after current observation supports exact alternative; no generic fatigue % reduction
autoregulation.overperformance: Record actual extra reserve/reps; hold rest of adequate session; evaluate between-cycle opportunity using repeated pattern
autoregulation.underperformance: Reconcile units/task/rest; no causal conclusion; named reduction/termination of future work only if adequate and authorized
autoregulation.unknown_rir: Do not award progression; reestablish reporting or use covered alternative method; HOLD only dependent judgment

missed_session.rule: Confirm actually missed versus unsynced. Preserve adequate remainder; no doubling sets/reps or automatic next-day makeup
missed_session.reschedule: Only if feasible, stimulus necessary and complete next-session/hybrid horizon valid; explicit material move confirmation
missed_session.progression: Missed opportunity is NOT_EVALUATED, not failed task or volume debt

deload_taper.deload: Use explicit reduced-work variant of same familiar configuration when reviewed; inspect need rather than fixed calendar/percentage
deload_taper.taper: Coordinate event objective and strength priority; no generic run taper automatically cancels strength
deload_taper.return: Known nonclinical pause requires new applicability/load context; clinical or unknown reason cannot use this generic recipe

substitutions.rule: Compare purpose, known competence/equipment, load basis, ROM/rest, demand and lost specificity; rebase configuration-specific history
substitutions.named_example: STR-LOWER-STRENGTH -> STR-SUB-DB only with known DB task loads; barbell strength specificity and dose not equivalent

demand_assessment.input_equation: Exercise metadata x prescription x athlete/context -> demand assessment. Keep local region exposure, systemic expectation, novelty, uncertainty and actual response separate; never multiply into an unvalidated universal score.
demand_assessment.qualitative: New configuration only eligible with separate known load baseline; otherwise familiarization/ASK
demand_assessment.local: Named primary/secondary group exposure plus task-specific observed response; no fixed recovery clock
demand_assessment.systemic: Qualitative expectation evaluated with full actual training history; no duplicate fatigue summation
demand_assessment.confidence: Conditional on context/familiarity; LOW if novelty/effort method uncertain

mutation_envelope.finite_reduction: If accepted beforehand: omit final accessory set OR omit final main set with lost stimulus visible; not interchangeable and not always sufficient
mutation_envelope.finite_progression: Own new configuration history; barbell PR/estimated 1RM is not migrated
mutation_envelope.forbidden: Unlisted load/reps/rest changes, novel substitution, independent modality replan or completed-set rewrite
mutation_envelope.completed_prefix: Immutable; only remaining sets can be proposed
mutation_envelope.inside: Only an already accepted named branch can execute as plan execution. A fresh change of the chosen plan requires B even within potential envelope; exact current agency and reviewed dose still required.

stop_hold_conditions: Persistent pain, injury/illness return, new functional limitation, pathology or clearance dependency -> CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED; no substitute dose
Unknown task eligibility/initial load or invalid equipment convention -> ASK/HOLD dependent task
Relevant task control loss -> stop set and reassess; no generic reduced load as clinical workaround

uncertainty_handling.confidence: No numeric score; rationale names method, history, applicability and data gap
uncertainty_handling.ASK: Only missing input that can change action; retain unsupported quantity null
uncertainty_handling.unsupported: Do not expose candidate finite dose as approved real prescription
